observation: The triage schema-alias guard compares provenance/provenanceFingerprint alias values with raw trimmed strings before canonical provenance normalization. Two syntactically different values that canonicalize to the same provenance identity can therefore trigger HOLD as a schema conflict even though downstream replay identity treats them as equivalent.
risk: False diagnostic HOLD caused by formatting-only provenance variation; this can block valid GUT-to-VAJRA regulation and make schema decoration alter organ behavior.
requiredFix: Compare provenance alias pairs using the same canonical provenance function used for receipt identity, while retaining fingerprint-only conflict evidence for genuinely distinct provenance values.
promotionRule: Do not promote until unit/adversarial tests prove canonical-equivalent provenance aliases pass, genuinely distinct aliases still HOLD, same-provenance echo suppression remains intact, and GUT/VAJRA cross-organ regressions pass in GitHub Actions.
privacy: Synthetic de-identified evidence only; no private Drive names, IDs, URLs, or source text.
